package example

import (
	"errors"

	sieve "sieve.client"
)

type Reconciler struct{ Calls int }

func (r *Reconciler) Reconcile(value int) (int, error) {
	sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeReconcile("example.(*Reconciler).Reconcile", r)   //sieve
	defer sieve.NotifyLearnAfterReconcile("example.(*Reconciler).Reconcile") //sieve
	r.Calls++
	if value < 0 {
		return -1, errors.New("negative")
	}
	return value * 2, nil
}
